about_the_game:
Struggling under crushing debt, you arrive in a mysterious town with one mission: survival. Your first job as a street cleaner helps keep the town tidy to attract travelers, but it barely scratches the surface of what you need to make ends meet.

To truly survive, you'll have to bend the rules—or break them entirely. Steal, gamble, kidnap, or explore other underhanded ways to earn quick cash.

Once you've scraped together your first fortune, it’s time to expand. Build your empire by running a scam centre, posting scam advertisements, and tricking unsuspecting victims.

You'll manage every aspect of your scam centre. Keep your workers productive—or exploit them until there's nothing left.

The choices are yours, but in this town, only the cunning thrive. Will you rise to dominate, or will the weight of your choices drag you down?

At the beginning of the game, you must ensure the city's cleanliness to earn wages and experience. A well-maintained city will attract more tourists. However, working diligently alone is almost impossible to repay the debt, so players will need to resort to some "special methods".

For example, you can steal and sell tourists' belongings. They can also place advertisements to attract more visitors. A sufficient number of tourists is essential to securing a steady income.

If a steal attempt fails or a tourist escapes, your wanted level will increase. You can use bribery to lower it. If the wanted level reaches the maximum, you will face punishment. In the game, you must continuously seek more skilled employees, better equipment, and more efficient working methods. 

Each debt comes with increasing interest, and the ultimate goal is to fully repay all debts. Failing to do so within the deadline will lead to different endings. There are also other gameplay elements in the game, which you can explore on your own.
